steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: A polis (city-state) was the fundamental political unit of ancient Greece, typically consisting of a city and its surrounding countryside

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Each polis was self-governing with its own laws, customs, constitution and patron deity

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Citizens (free adult males) had political rights and duties; women, slaves and metics (foreign residents) were excluded from citizenship

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The acropolis (high city) was the religious and defensive centre; the agora was the marketplace and civic meeting place

steps.title: Try it yourself
